metadata.title: About
metadata.description: BIShare is the fastest way to move and share your files across every device — local speed when you're nearby, a link when you're not. Private by design, no ads, no tracking.

hero.title: All your files, finally together
hero.subtitle: BIShare exists so that moving and sharing your files across every device is one thing, in one app — not three.

story.title: Why we built it
story.p1: <highlight>We started BIShare because moving a file between your own devices shouldn't require a cloud round-trip —</highlight> and sending one across the world shouldn't mean a slow, clunky upload. Sharing with the person next to you was somehow harder than sharing across the planet.
story.p2: So we built one tool for all of it. Move files at local speed when your devices are near, and send a link they open in any browser when they're far. Local speed, cloud ease — one app.

quote.text: We wanted the digital equivalent of handing something over.

values.title: Four things we won't compromise on

items.title: Private first
items.desc: Encryption isn't a feature tier. Every transfer is end-to-end encrypted — always, for everyone.

items.title: Fast is a feature
items.desc: Nearby transfers run at the speed of your network, on a transfer engine built in Rust and tuned byte by byte.

items.title: Quietly simple
items.desc: The best sharing tool is the one you stop noticing. Fewer taps, fewer decisions, fewer surprises.

items.title: For every device
items.desc: One app across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux — available in 13 languages.

privacy.title: Where your files go — and where they don't
privacy.body: The panel on the right is our whole stance in miniature — the policy itself is just as direct.
commitments: Nearby transfers travel device-to-device and never touch a server
Remote shares live on secure cloud infrastructure for 24 hours, then are deleted
Everything is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and X25519 key exchange
One-time links destroy themselves after a single download
No ads, no tracking, no selling data — ever

technology.title: Engineered, not assembled
technology.body: BIShare runs on a custom transfer protocol written in Rust — zero-copy decoding, streaming encryption, adaptive chunking — shared by every platform we ship. The same engine that moves a 40 GB folder across your studio Wi-Fi also secures a 2 MB PDF on its way around the world. One codebase, five platforms, no compromises between them.

get.title: Get BIShare
get.body: Free on the App Store and Google Play — or share straight from your browser, no install needed.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.body: Questions, feedback, or partnership inquiries — we read everything.
